rateLimits.note: GraphQL primary limit: 5,000 points an hour per user (10,000 for a GitHub App of an Enterprise Cloud organization; up to 12,500 per App installation). A query costs at least one point (more with many nodes): the guard counts one per call, a lower bound; GitHub's x-ratelimit-* fields (read with their epoch reset) hold the rest.
GraphQL secondary limit: no more than 2,000 points a minute.

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: 5,000 points an hour per user, 2,000 points a minute, 100 concurrent requests (shared with REST: concurrency); a secondary limit answers 200 or 403 with Retry-After. The Terms of Service (H, API Terms) forbid sharing tokens to exceed the limits and may suspend abusive use; they set nothing on commercial use, caching or storage of what the API gives: unknown. The GitHub Sponsors Additional Terms do not address a third party showing sponsors. GitHub asks every API request for a User-Agent (the provider sends one).
